Docket 1.3.98

**Docket now runs on Intel Macs. Download the Intel version from docketseo.app/download/. It is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score and how many problems each area has. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $349, or 4 payments of $87.25, to see what they are, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *Intel Macs.* Until now Docket ran only on Macs with Apple silicon. This

  licence. One licence covers up to three Macs of either kind. Each copy

99 checks across 13 areas.
